name: What to Expect During Your Full Bathroom Renovation Project

step.name: Step 1: Define Scope and Budget. This is where you clarify what you want to achieve with your renovation and how much you're looking to spend. It’s crucial to be realistic about both. Your contractor will help you fine-tune the details, making sure your vision aligns with your budget and structural possibilities. This phase includes confirming the layout and discussing what fixtures and materials you're dreaming of.
step.text: Step 1: Define Scope and Budget. This is where you clarify what you want to achieve with your renovation and how much you're looking to spend. It’s crucial to be realistic about both. Your contractor will help you fine-tune the details, making sure your vision aligns with your budget and structural possibilities. This phase includes confirming the layout and discussing what fixtures and materials you're dreaming of.

step.name: Step 2: Material Selection and Permits. Once the scope is clear, you'll select all your materials and fixtures, from tiles to vanity to showerheads. At the same time, your contractor will check for and acquire any necessary permits. This is super important if you're making changes to plumbing, electrical, or structural elements, as local jurisdictions like those in the East Bay Area have specific requirements. Don't skip this; it prevents future headaches.

step.name: Step 3: Demolition and Rough-Ins. This is when things get a bit messy! The old bathroom is removed, clearing the way for the new. After demolition, the framing, plumbing, and electrical rough-ins happen. This means getting all the pipes and wires in their correct, new locations before walls are sealed up. Inspections usually occur at this point to ensure everything is up to code.

step.name: Step 4: Waterproofing and Surface Installation. With the rough-ins complete and inspected, wet areas like showers and around tubs are carefully waterproofed. Then comes the installation of drywall, followed by tiling for floors and walls. This stage really starts to give shape to your new bathroom. Precise work here is key for both aesthetics and long-term durability.

step.name: Step 5: Fixture and Cabinet Installation. Now for the exciting part – seeing your selections come to life! Your vanity, cabinets, toilet, and all the chosen fixtures like sinks and faucets are installed. The contractor will also handle finishes like painting and trim work. This is when your bathroom truly begins to look like the space you envisioned.

step.name: Step 6: Testing, Inspections, and Final Touches. Before completion, everything is tested, especially plumbing for leaks. A final inspection ensures all work meets local standards. Any remaining small details are addressed, and the space is cleaned up. This is your chance to do a final walkthrough with your contractor and confirm everything is just right.
step.text: What to Expect During the Process Throughout your renovation, you can expect regular communication from your contractor. Frasheski Construction prides itself on hands-on involvement, ensuring quality every step of the way. You'll see your bathroom transform from concept to reality, with careful attention paid to each detail. Remember that timelines can shift slightly if unforeseen issues arise, but a good contractor will keep you informed. Ready to get started on your full bathroom renovation? Reach out to Frasheski Construction.
